title: verify_evolution_api_webhook_signature_verification
description: Test POST /api/evo/webhook/{token} endpoint to ensure it accepts requests with valid Webhook-Signature header and rejects requests with missing or invalid signature with 401 Unauthorized.

title: validate_whatsapp_webhook_payload_sanitization
description: Test POST /api/whatsapp/webhook endpoint to verify incoming WhatsApp message payloads are sanitized properly to prevent stored XSS and injection before persisting, ensuring sanitized data is stored and used internally.

title: enforce_multitenant_broadcasting_channel_authorization
description: Test POST /broadcasting/auth endpoint to confirm that channel subscription authorization is enforced per tenant, allowing access only to channels belonging to the authenticated tenant and denying cross-tenant access with 403 Forbidden.

title: test_antiban_and_rate_control_on_whatsapp_instance_connect
description: Test POST /api/whatsapp/instances/{id}/connect endpoint to verify AntiBanManager schedules outbound messages with randomized delays, enforces rate limits returning 429 on excess calls, and validates media integrity returning 422 on invalid Base64.

title: verify_webhook_throttling_and_queue_failure_alerts
description: Test POST /api/whatsapp/webhook and POST /api/webhooks/asaas endpoints to ensure per-route rate limiting is applied returning 429 on flood, webhook jobs are queued and processed, and failed jobs trigger alerts visible on /admin dashboard for super-admins.
